description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeSupervisorModel, which serializes and represents supervisor and reporting method information related to an employee within the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes traits and annotations for API schema documentation and specifies data filters and attribute mappings.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes supervisor data and reporting method information related to an employee for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ReportTo entity and sets data filters and attribute mappings.
